gazette_location.description_raw_en: No. 1241.—COLONIAL SECRETARIAT. It is hereby notified that the following thoroughfare will be known in future as described hereunder:— Cul-de-sac commencing at its junction with Castle Road between House No. 3A and House No. 7, 'Kom-Tong Hall', running in a south-westerly direction for some 75 yards, deflecting 90° to the left at two points, one at some 30 yards and the other at some 75 yards from Castle Road, both running in a south-easterly direction for some 33 yards as shown coloured pink on Drawing No. R.H. 818. English Name: CASTLE LANE. Chinese Name: 衛城里.
